description: This is a command-line interface script for a universal project initializer. It handles command-line arguments, creates project configurations, and manages template creation and output for initializing various types of software projects. It also supports fetching the run command for specific project types.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a string of comma-separated key=value pairs into a dictionary with proper type conversions.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig for retrieving template info, with default values.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary with absolute paths for init files, suitable for JSON serialization.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs a standardized JSON response indicating success/failure and related info.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a specific project type as a JSON object.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the --get-run-command functionality: retrieves and outputs the run command for a given project type.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up argument parsing, handles project initialization or fetching run commands, and manages overall program flow.

ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
